title: fileRouter
summary: Configure flat route discovery and development server transport.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: directory defaults to src/routes. To use manual tables, provide both clientRoutes and serverRoutes paths relative to the Vite project.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: A Vite plugin. fileRouter is an alias of routerPlugin.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Import this API from one of the entry points listed above. Framework APIs are available from both /react and /preact.

sections.title: Behavior and edge cases
sections.body: Requires Vite 8 or newer. Import virtual:smolter/routes for the generated table. Server loader/action exports must be named re-exports from separate files. Export-star and inline server handlers are rejected in browser route modules. The plugin handles development requests; production still needs a server adapter.
